body: When Future heard Southside’s beat and immediately started freestyling When Future randomly pulled up on Southside’s live, he didn’t need a studio setup or a written verse to make the moment memorable. He heard the beat playing and immediately started freestyling over it, sliding into the pocket like he had already heard the song a hundred times. That’s the kind of chemistry Future and Southside have built over the years.

source_caption_text:
When Future heard Southside’s beat and immediately started freestyling

When Future randomly pulled up on Southside’s live, he didn’t need a studio setup or a written verse to make the moment memorable. He heard the beat playing and immediately started freestyling over it, sliding into the pocket like he had already heard the song a hundred times.

That’s the kind of chemistry Future and Southside have built over the years. There’s something different about watching Future hear a beat for the first time and instantly find a flow for it. No preparation, no second takes, just Future doing what he does best.
